claims.content: To close a reversible-lane entrance by closing its Entrance devices according to the specified closing sequence.

goal.raw_text: To close a reversible-lane entrance by closing its Entrance devices according to the specified closing sequence.

claims.content: Operator
The operator has logged on at a control unit console.
The CMS messages for the entrance are set to “Open” before being changed to “Closed”.
The Operator initiates a closing sequence to close the Entrance devices of a reversible-lane entrance.

trigger.raw_text: The Operator initiates a closing sequence to close the Entrance devices of a reversible-lane entrance.

claims.content: The closing sequence closes Entrance devices in the following order: CMS.
CMS messages are changed from “Open” to “Closed” beginning with the farthest upstream sign (furthest away from the entrance) and proceeding, in order, downstream (towards the entrance).

The system provides a specific delay between the message change on each sign and the message change on the next downstream sign; the delay for each sign pair equals the time to travel between the two signs at a system specified speed.
Entrance Longitudinal Pop-ups are closed in the direction of adjacent freeway traffic, beginning at the shoulder edge and proceeding toward the entrance ramp nose.
If more than one bank, Entrance Transverse Pop-ups are closed in the direction from the freeway toward the reversible lanes.
Wrong Way Longitudinal Pop-ups are closed beginning at the shoulder edge, and progressing toward the ramp nose, next to the reversible lanes.
If multiple entrances exist on the reversible lanes in the direction of travel being closed, the specific order in which those entrances are closed presents no ‘wrong way’ safety issues.

If the TMC workstations or network server fails, resulting in loss of field status at the TMC, alternate control shall be at FCU South or FCU North; the operator shall be able to dial in from a back up computer to either FCU North or FCU south and open and close the reversible lanes. Exit: alternate control at FCU South or FCU North via back up computer.

If FCU North or South fails (FCU Controller failures or FCU-TSU communications failure), causing loss of changeable messages signs and DCUs associated with the failed FCU, alternate control at the non-failed FCU (North or South). Exit: alternate control at the non-failed FCU.

If FCUs North and South both fail (FCU Controller failures or FCUs-TSU and FCU-FCU communications failure), causing loss of changeable message signs 1-12 and DCUs 1-5, alternate control units: Direct control at DCUs 1-5. Exit: direct control at DCUs 1-5.
The Entrance devices for the reversible-lane entrance have been closed in the specified closing sequence order.
CMS messages have been changed from “Open” to “Closed”, beginning with the farthest upstream sign (furthest away from the entrance) and proceeding downstream (towards the entrance).

A specific delay was provided between the message change on each sign and the message change on the next downstream sign; the delay for each sign pair equals the time to travel between the two signs at a system specified speed.
Entrance Longitudinal Pop-ups have been closed in the direction of adjacent freeway traffic, beginning at the shoulder edge and proceeding toward the entrance ramp nose.
If more than one bank, Entrance Transverse Pop-ups have been closed in the direction from the freeway toward the reversible lanes.
Wrong Way Longitudinal Pop-ups have been closed beginning at the shoulder edge, and progressing toward the ramp nose, next to the reversible lanes.
